name: AskSolique
tagline: Source-cited Indian tax research and AI-assisted drafting for professionals.
description: AskSolique is a browser-based research workspace for Indian CA firms, company secretaries, tax professionals and business teams. It covers income tax, GST, FEMA, SEBI, customs and corporate law with source citations. Users can combine research with AI-assisted document drafting and a personalised knowledge base. Team plans support shared credits. Outputs require professional review. A seven-day free trial includes starter credits without a card; paid credit packs and monthly or annual plans are available.
